newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sees June sale of 25 pct of Svyazinvest.
newsitem.headline: Russia sees June sale of 25 pct of Svyazinvest.

text.p: Russia will probably sell a stake of 25 percent plus one share in telecom holding company AO Svyazinvest in June at a starting price of $1.18 billion, a senior privatisation official said on Monday.

"I can't name a definite date now, but it won't be in May," Russian Federal Property Fund first deputy chairman Vladimir Malin told Reuters. "We're trying to do it as fast as possible -- I think it will happen in June."

Malin confirmed foreigners would be allowed to bid for the stake and that it would be sold as one unit, giving the holder power to block any changes to the charter of Svyazinvest, which holds controlling stakes in most regional Russian telecoms.
A government order dated May 23 called for new shares in Svyazinvest to be issued.

"In order to conduct the auction, we have to carry out quite a few organisational procedures to register the new charter capital," Malin said. "Carrying this out could take up a certain amount of time."
The order said that part of the proceeds of the sale would be channeled into Svyazinvest for investment, and not simply go to the government.
